description:
*July 10*
Media Suite Migration:
Created a dedicated MediaSuiteView component and migrated media-centric tools out of StudioView (Creation Studio).
Moved tools include: SegCarver (formerly a modal, now embedded), Video Script Writer, Script Writer, and Image Describer.
Media Suite UI/UX:
Added a View Mode Toggle to switch the Media Suite layout between a responsive Grid and a List view.
Integrated the global Theme Cycler into the Media Suite header for immediate visual customization.
*July 08*
**Updated Settings Panel and added a third provider option: 
-Custom OpenAI-Compatible.
Add fields for Base URL, API Key, Model Name, and API Path.
Create a secure server-side API proxy route /api/custom-ai in the backend server to securely handle requests without exposing credentials.
Integrate the new provider into the chat hooks so the entire media aggregation/workspace flows smoothly with the custom endpoints!
**Enhancements & Features
-Finance Intell Registry Component: Created a version-controlled log and interactive spreadsheet desk matching the design aesthetics of the Studio Registry.
-Comprehensive Registry Database: Populated with 9 detailed, descriptive specifications detailing titles, categories, versions, creation dates, status flags, developers, tech stack dependencies, and summaries for all components inside the 
-Finance Intell studio.
Fully Searchable & Filterable: Integrated dynamic multi-keyword search inputs along with category buttons to seamlessly filter down results.
-Multi-Field Sorting: Allows instant ascending and descending sorting by # ID, App Name / Title, Created Date, or Version.
-Editable Specifications: Users and developers can click any row to reveal a detailed slide-out specification card. Clicking Edit Specifications opens inline input forms where they can modify metadata or delete records.
-Log Creation: Added an Add Tool Spec button, enabling users to register new custom tools or project ideas to the registry.
-Persistence & Recovery: Backed by localStorage to preserve all database edits and custom additions across sessions. Includes a Reset button to restore initial defaults.
Spreadsheet Exports: Supports exporting the entire registry spreadsheet instantly to Excel CSV (.csv) or Plain Text (.txt) files.
Launch Action: Fully functional Launch Applet button directly links from the drawer back into the chosen tool.
-Header Integration:
Positioned an elegant, high-contrast, glowing gradient "info" access button in the top navigation bar of the Finance Intell section.
-Supports perfect compatibility with all 11 color themes  updated the core state engines of all seven suites to support an on-demand, togglable knowledge base:
Website Builder (WebsiteBuilder.tsx)
Creative Brainstormer (Brainstormer.tsx)
Email Drafter (EmailDrafter.tsx)
Marketing Copywriter (MarketingCopywriter.tsx)
SWOT Analysis Strategic Desk (SwotAnalysis.tsx)
Code Explainer (CodeExplainer.tsx)
Ebook Outline & Chapter Generator (EbookGenerator.tsx)
Each tool now features an elegant Knowledge base option card containing a checkbox:
Checked (Default): Leverages active session context files (session.mediaItems) to ground copywriting, code explanation, and SWOT modeling in actual documents.
Unchecked: Seamlessly ignores workspace documents to execute general, unconstrained creative writing, logic brainstorming, or ad copy drafting.
